purpose: Provenance for the 50-question FRAMES baseline set (seed 42, size 50). Run with --question-ids from eval/baseline_50_question_ids.txt, never --sample-size.

selection.sampler: random.Random(42).sample over 822 TSV rows in frames.py:57

notes.excluded_141_540: Not in the corpus at all; the TSV holds 822 rows and neither ID is loadable. Neither appears in this set.
notes.id_823_simple_english: Present in the corpus but NOT selected into this set, so the Simple English article does not affect this baseline.
notes.size10_relation: The seed-42/size-10 set is an exact PREFIX (first 10 entries) of this list, hence a strict subset. Verified empirically, not assumed.
notes.document_counts: mean 3.22 gold docs/question, min 2 (Q104), max 9 (Q716), 161 doc-loads total across the 50.
notes.max_run_tokens_raised: Raised from 200000 (baseline.yaml) to 600000 in the pinned config only. Measured: at 200000, Q25 and Q783 exhausted the budget inside the worker stage and returned no answer, which runner.py:88 records as correct=False. At 600000 both complete and grade correct. Worst observed input tokens 338806 (Q783), 1.8x headroom. run_timeout_seconds 900 is now the binding limit; worst observed 79.6s.
notes.endpoint: Self-hosted OpenAI-compatible endpoint serving vLLM 0.32.1rc1.dev555+geca54bd1d-tp4 (from system_fingerprint); host supplied via OPENAI_BASE_URL and intentionally not recorded here. seed is accepted but confers no determinism: temperature 0 is greedy so there is no sampling RNG, and tensor-parallel reduction order under continuous batching is not controllable by any request parameter.

derived_subsets.stable_38_definition: correct in all 3 runs AND semantically stable
derived_subsets.injection_ready_29_definition: the 38 plus an automatically verified injection target
